consolidation_candidates.recommended_plan: Create a read-only package_event_overlay view/index plan over package queue and package_event_index refs; do not migrate source DB rows.
Use package_event_index as the first overlay; add derived views/indexes only after proving request/response refs and counts.
Create a derived index that joins journal entry refs to package_event_index refs; keep journal as canonical history.

consolidation_candidates.concept: St. Anne's work-log staging indexes if safe
consolidation_candidates.recommended_plan: Keep staged work logs isolated until operator confirmation; future overlay may expose package/work-log staging indexes without workbook mutation.

do_not_touch_databases.reason: Business ledger and ledger-shaped databases are protected; consolidation risk is forbidden.
Archives/backups remain historical evidence until separately reviewed.
Unknown ownership defaults to no writes and manual review.
Privacy/protected evidence such as token vaults must never enter read-model consolidation.
Token, secret, credential, and vault stores must not enter read-model or workflow consolidation.

keep_isolated_databases.reason: Test harness and pytest databases cannot become canonical truth.
Generated proof/status stores are evidence unless a future owner map proves otherwise.
One-off proof/read-model databases should stay as source evidence, not merged into canonical workflow state.
Dry-run, smoke, and warmup databases are validation artifacts, not canonical state.

migration_requirements_before_any_consol.description: Create verified backups of every source database before any future write.
Compare schemas and table contracts before creating any overlay or migration target.
Record pre/post row counts for every affected table.
Record checksums or sample-row proof for every affected table before and after any future write.
Document exact rollback steps and owners before changes.
Add focused tests for joins, refs, permissions, and forbidden state mixing.
Prove protected ledger databases are excluded from package/agent/read-model stores.
Require explicit operator approval for any database write, index, view, migration, move, or delete.

never_consolidate: Never consolidate ledger into package DB.
Never consolidate secrets/tokens into read models.
Never consolidate raw prompt bodies into operator journal.
Never consolidate test harness into canonical state.
purpose: Planning-only SQLite consolidation plan based on governance registry, canonical state map, agentic chain inspector, and package event index.

notes: This task does not create the views or indexes.
Use package_event_index as the cross-reference layer between package queue, request/response, and operator conversation refs.
If indexes/views are written inside existing databases later, that still requires operator approval.
A detached generated overlay/read-model is lower risk than altering canonical source databases.
recommended_first_low_risk_move.summary: Create views/indexes over existing package/event/journal refs, not a data migration; use package_event_index as the cross-reference layer.

notes: Require a classification packet before any future consolidation decision.
